settings.title: Risk Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure global risk engine state, physical connection filtering, and maintenance exemptions
settings.enabled_desc: Enable sliding-window rate limiting, challenge escalation, and automatic threat bans platform-wide
settings.ip_filter_desc: Reject requests from blacklisted IPs at gateway/filter level with HTTP 403
settings.default_duration_desc: Default validity period for auto-triggered or unspecified bans (1440 mins = 24 hours)
settings.ban_notice_desc: Notice message displayed to intercepted clients in the API response
settings.bypass_loopback_desc: Automatically exempt 127.0.0.1, ::1 and container health checks to avoid false positives
settings.captcha_enabled_desc: Require captchas for benign requests; when disabled, low-risk requests pass freely while high-risk triggers challenges
settings.captcha_tolerance_desc: Allowed dragging deviation in pixels to pass the challenge (recommended: 6-10px)
settings.captcha_ticket_ttl_desc: Validity duration of tickets generated upon successful puzzle completion (default: 300s)
settings.captcha_max_attempts_desc: Consecutive wrong attempts triggering rate limiting or threat escalation
settings.captcha_force_reset_desc: Always require captcha challenge during password recovery/reset flows

policy.title: Policy Settings
policy.subtitle: Unified policies for email registration whitelist, multi-dimensional rate-limiting interception matrix, challenge steps, and auto-ban rules

email.title: Registration Email Domain Whitelist
email.desc: Configure allowed email domain suffixes for user registration. When enabled, only emails matching the whitelist are allowed to register. If empty, any valid email is allowed.
email.input_placeholder: Enter domain suffix, e.g. edu.cn or pku.edu.cn (Press Enter or click Add)
email.input_hint: Rule Note: Matches the domain and its subdomains (e.g., entering edu.cn allows all *.edu.cn emails). Leading {'@'} and case sensitivity are handled automatically.
email.empty_desc: The platform currently allows any valid public or organization email. To restrict registration to specific institutions, add domain suffixes above.
email.rule_pattern_text: Only permits emails matching {'@'}{suffix} or ending with .{suffix}
email.clear_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all email domain suffixes? This will permit any valid email to register.
email.duplicate_error: This email domain suffix already exists in the whitelist
email.invalid_error: Please enter a valid domain suffix (e.g. edu.cn or company.com)

interception.rate_limit_window_desc: Per-IP sliding-window frequency control statistics period (range: 10 - 600 seconds)
interception.rate_limit_max_requests_desc: Max requests allowed per IP within the window period; exceeding will return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests

policy.failures_medium_desc: Escalate line captcha to distorted shear captcha after this many failures in 10 minutes
policy.failures_high_desc: Mandate sliding puzzle behavior challenge after this many failures in 10 minutes
policy.failures_ban_desc: Automatically blacklist and ban IP when reaching this failure count (0 to disable auto-ban)
policy.velocity_medium_desc: Trigger medium-risk rate-limit protection when requests exceed this velocity
policy.account_failures_medium_desc: Protect against distributed credential stuffing across residential proxy pools
policy.account_failures_high_desc: Require out-of-band email OTP dynamic code when account failures exceed this threshold
policy.recovery_step_desc: Penalty reduction count deducted after successfully passing behavior verification
policy.reset_success: Reset to recommended default policy parameters
